en.title: Trump briefed on Iran blockade, cancels Kansas, Iowa rallies, shifts to tele‑rallies
en.dek: President Trump cancelled two in‑person midterm rallies, will join tele‑rallies in 19 states, and received briefings on Iran and Ukraine as the election approaches.
facts: Trump cancelled in‑person rallies in Salina, Kansas, and Dubuque, Iowa on 30 October (The Jerusalem Post, CNA).
The Republican National Committee announced Trump will appear in tele‑rallies across 19 states (RNC statement, 30 October).
Adm. Brad Cooper briefed Trump on the Iran naval blockade on 29 October (Axios, The Jerusalem Post).
Local stations reported the Ukraine war continues despite Trump’s promise to end it (Fox5 Vegas and others, 29 October).
Likud and allies secured 53 seats in Israel’s 120‑seat Knesset, short of a majority (The Jerusalem Post, BBC).
Benjamin Netanyahu’s party claimed the Israeli election was stolen (South China Morning Post, Washington Post).
body: The Republican National Committee said on 30 October that President Trump will appear in tele‑rallies across 19 states (RNC). The broadcasts follow the cancellation of his in‑person events in Iowa and Kansas (CNA).

Trump cancelled in‑person rallies scheduled for Saturday in Salina, Kansas, and Sunday in Dubuque, Iowa (The Jerusalem Post, CNA). He said he will phone into other campaign events instead of traveling (The Jerusalem Post).

U.S. Central Command chief Admiral Brad Cooper briefed President Trump on Thursday about the state of the Iran naval blockade (Axios, The Jerusalem Post). The briefing covered the blockade’s status and possible military options (Axios).

Local television stations reported that the war in Ukraine continues despite President Trump’s promise to end it (Fox5 Vegas and other stations). No ceasefire was announced, and fighting persisted on the front lines (Fox5 Vegas).

The Jerusalem Post reported that the bloc led by Benjamin Netanyahu’s Likud won 53 seats in the 120‑seat Knesset (The Jerusalem Post, BBC). The total falls short of a majority, meaning coalition talks will be required (BBC).

Benjamin Netanyahu’s party alleged that the Israeli election was stolen (South China Morning Post). The Washington Post said Netanyahu made the claim while seeking political survival (Washington Post).

Vice President JD Vance wrote to a senior Iranian official about medical supplies, and President Trump said the outreach concerned medical supplies (The Straits Times, Euronews). Trump emphasized the humanitarian focus of the contact (The Straits Times).
en.context: The 2026 U.S. midterm elections are scheduled for November, prompting heightened campaign activity. Axios and The Jerusalem Post reported that the United States is monitoring conflicts in Iran, Ukraine and Israel as the election approaches.

de.title: Trump über Iran-Blockade informiert, sagt Kundgebungen in Kansas und Iowa ab, setzt auf Tele-Rallies
de.dek: Präsident Trump hat zwei persönliche Kundgebungen zu den Zwischenwahlen abgesagt, wird an Tele-Rallies in 19 Bundesstaaten teilnehmen und wurde im Vorfeld der Wahl über den Iran und die Ukraine informiert.
facts: Trump sagte persönliche Kundgebungen in Salina, Kansas, und Dubuque, Iowa, am 30. Oktober ab (The Jerusalem Post, CNA).
Das Nationale Komitee der Republikaner gab bekannt, dass Trump in Tele-Rallies in 19 Bundesstaaten auftreten wird (RNC-Erklärung, 30. Oktober).
Admiral Brad Cooper informierte Trump am 29. Oktober über die iranische Seeblockade (Axios, The Jerusalem Post).
Lokale Sender berichteten, dass der Ukraine-Krieg trotz Trumps Versprechen, ihn zu beenden, andauert (Fox5 Vegas und andere, 29. Oktober).
Die Likud und ihre Verbündeten sicherten sich 53 Sitze in der 120-sitzigen Knesset Israels, was nicht für eine Mehrheit reicht (The Jerusalem Post, BBC).
Benjamin Netanjahus Partei behauptete, die israelische Wahl sei gestohlen worden (South China Morning Post, Washington Post).
body: Das Nationale Komitee der Republikaner teilte am 30. Oktober mit, dass Präsident Trump in Tele-Rallies in 19 Bundesstaaten auftreten wird (RNC). Die Übertragungen erfolgen nach der Absage seiner persönlichen Veranstaltungen in Iowa und Kansas (CNA).

Trump sagte persönliche Kundgebungen ab, die für Samstag in Salina, Kansas, und Sonntag in Dubuque, Iowa, geplant waren (The Jerusalem Post, CNA). Er erklärte, er werde stattdessen telefonisch an anderen Wahlkampfveranstaltungen teilnehmen, anstatt zu reisen (The Jerusalem Post).

Der Chef des U.S. Central Command, Admiral Brad Cooper, informierte Präsident Trump am Donnerstag über den Stand der iranischen Seeblockade (Axios, The Jerusalem Post). Das Briefing behandelte den Status der Blockade und mögliche militärische Optionen (Axios).

Lokale Fernsehsender berichteten, dass der Krieg in der Ukraine trotz des Versprechens von Präsident Trump, ihn zu beenden, andauere (Fox5 Vegas und andere Sender). Es wurde kein Waffenstillstand bekannt gegeben, und die Kämpfe an den Frontlinien hielten an (Fox5 Vegas).

The Jerusalem Post berichtete, dass der von Benjamin Netanjahus Likud geführte Block 53 Sitze in der 120-sitzigen Knesset gewann (The Jerusalem Post, BBC). Die Gesamtzahl reicht nicht für eine Mehrheit aus, was Koalitionsgespräche erforderlich macht (BBC).

Benjamin Netanjahus Partei behauptete, die israelische Wahl sei gestohlen worden (South China Morning Post). Die Washington Post schrieb, Netanjahu habe diese Behauptung im Kampf um sein politisches Überleben aufgestellt (Washington Post).

Vizepräsident JD Vance schrieb an einen hochrangigen iranischen Beamten über medizinische Hilfsgüter, und Präsident Trump sagte, die Kontaktaufnahme beträfe medizinische Vorräte (The Straits Times, Euronews). Trump betonte den humanitären Fokus des Kontakts (The Straits Times).
de.context: Axios und die Jerusalem Post berichteten, dass die Vereinigten Staaten mehrere Überseekonflikte beobachten, während die Zwischenwahlen 2026 näher rücken. Die Konflikte umfassen den Iran, die Ukraine und Israel.

fr.title: Trump briefé sur le blocus de l'Iran, annule ses rassemblements au Kansas et en Iowa et opte pour des meetings virtuels
fr.dek: À l'approche des élections, le président Trump a annulé deux rassemblements physiques de mi-mandat, participera à des meetings virtuels dans 19 États et a été briefé sur les situations en Iran et en Ukraine.
facts: Trump a annulé ses rassemblements physiques prévus le 30 octobre à Salina, au Kansas, et à Dubuque, en Iowa (The Jerusalem Post, CNA).
Le Comité national républicain a annoncé que Trump interviendra lors de meetings virtuels dans 19 États (communiqué du RNC, 30 octobre).
L'amiral Brad Cooper a briefé Trump sur le blocus naval de l'Iran le 29 octobre (Axios, The Jerusalem Post).
Des stations locales ont rapporté que la guerre en Ukraine se poursuit malgré la promesse de Trump d'y mettre fin (Fox5 Vegas et autres, 29 octobre).
Le Likoud et ses alliés ont obtenu 53 sièges sur les 120 de la Knesset israélienne, soit moins que la majorité (The Jerusalem Post, BBC).
Le parti de Benjamin Netanyahu a affirmé que l'élection israélienne avait été volée (South China Morning Post, Washington Post).
body: Le Comité national républicain a annoncé le 30 octobre que le président Trump participera à des meetings virtuels dans 19 États (RNC). Ces diffusions font suite à l'annulation de ses événements physiques en Iowa et au Kansas (CNA).

Trump a annulé les rassemblements prévus samedi à Salina, au Kansas, et dimanche à Dubuque, en Iowa (The Jerusalem Post, CNA). Il a précisé qu'il interviendrait par téléphone lors d'autres événements de campagne plutôt que de se déplacer (The Jerusalem Post).

Le chef du Commandement central des États-Unis, l'amiral Brad Cooper, a briefé le président Trump jeudi sur l'état du blocus naval de l'Iran (Axios, The Jerusalem Post). Le briefing a porté sur le statut du blocus et les options militaires envisageables (Axios).

Des stations de télévision locales ont rapporté que la guerre en Ukraine se poursuit malgré la promesse du président Trump d'y mettre fin (Fox5 Vegas et d'autres stations). Aucun cessez-le-feu n'a été annoncé et les combats persistent sur la ligne de front (Fox5 Vegas).

Le Jerusalem Post a rapporté que le bloc dirigé par le Likoud de Benjamin Netanyahu a remporté 53 sièges à la Knesset, qui en compte 120 (The Jerusalem Post, BBC). Ce total est insuffisant pour obtenir la majorité, ce qui nécessitera des négociations de coalition (BBC).

Le parti de Benjamin Netanyahu a allégué que l'élection israélienne avait été volée (South China Morning Post). Le Washington Post a indiqué que Netanyahu avait formulé cette affirmation dans un effort de survie politique (Washington Post).

Le vice-président JD Vance a écrit à un haut responsable iranien au sujet de fournitures médicales, et le président Trump a précisé que cette prise de contact concernait des aides médicales (The Straits Times, Euronews). Trump a insisté sur la dimension humanitaire de cet échange (The Straits Times).
fr.context: Les élections de mi-mandat américaines de 2026 sont prévues pour novembre, entraînant une intensification des activités de campagne. Axios et The Jerusalem Post ont rapporté que les États-Unis surveillent les conflits en Iran, en Ukraine et en Israël à l'approche du scrutin.

es.title: Trump recibe un informe sobre el bloqueo a Irán, cancela mítines en Kansas e Iowa y opta por eventos telemáticos
es.dek: El presidente Trump ha cancelado dos mítines presenciales de cara a las elecciones de mitad de mandato, participará en eventos telemáticos en 19 estados y ha sido informado sobre la situación en Irán y Ucrania.
facts: Trump canceló los mítines presenciales previstos para el 30 de octubre en Salina (Kansas) y Dubuque (Iowa) (The Jerusalem Post, CNA).
El Comité Nacional Republicano anunció que Trump participará en mítines telemáticos en 19 estados (comunicado del RNC, 30 de octubre).
El almirante Brad Cooper informó a Trump sobre el bloqueo naval a Irán el 29 de octubre (Axios, The Jerusalem Post).
Estaciones locales informaron que la guerra de Ucrania continúa a pesar de la promesa de Trump de ponerle fin (Fox5 Vegas y otros, 29 de octubre).
Likud y sus aliados obtuvieron 53 escaños en la Knesset de Israel, que tiene 120 asientos, quedando cortos de la mayoría (The Jerusalem Post, BBC).
El partido de Benjamin Netanyahu afirmó que las elecciones israelíes fueron fraudulentas (South China Morning Post, Washington Post).
body: El Comité Nacional Republicano informó el 30 de octubre que el presidente Trump participará en mítines telemáticos en 19 estados (RNC). Estas transmisiones se producen tras la cancelación de sus eventos presenciales en Iowa y Kansas (CNA).

Trump canceló los mítines presenciales programados para el sábado en Salina (Kansas) y el domingo en Dubuque (Iowa) (The Jerusalem Post, CNA). El mandatario señaló que intervendrá telefónicamente en otros eventos de campaña en lugar de desplazarse (The Jerusalem Post).

El jefe del Comando Central de EE. UU., el almirante Brad Cooper, informó al presidente Trump el jueves sobre el estado del bloqueo naval a Irán (Axios, The Jerusalem Post). El informe detalló la situación del bloqueo y las posibles opciones militares (Axios).

Estaciones de televisión locales informaron que la guerra en Ucrania continúa a pesar de la promesa del presidente Trump de ponerle fin (Fox5 Vegas y otras emisoras). No se anunció ningún alto el fuego y los combates persistieron en las líneas del frente (Fox5 Vegas).

The Jerusalem Post informó que el bloque liderado por el partido Likud de Benjamin Netanyahu obtuvo 53 escaños en la Knesset, que cuenta con 120 asientos (The Jerusalem Post, BBC). La cifra total es insuficiente para alcanzar la mayoría, por lo que serán necesarias negociaciones para formar una coalición (BBC).

El partido de Benjamin Netanyahu alegó que las elecciones israelíes fueron fraudulentas (South China Morning Post). El Washington Post señaló que Netanyahu realizó esta afirmación en un intento por asegurar su supervivencia política (Washington Post).

El vicepresidente JD Vance escribió a un alto funcionario iraní sobre suministros médicos, y el presidente Trump afirmó que el contacto se refería a dichos suministros (The Straits Times, Euronews). Trump subrayó el enfoque humanitario de la comunicación (The Straits Times).
es.context: Las elecciones de mitad de mandato de EE. UU. de 2026 están programadas para noviembre, lo que ha intensificado la actividad de campaña. Axios y The Jerusalem Post informaron que Estados Unidos vigila los conflictos en Irán, Ucrania e Israel ante la proximidad de los comicios.

it.title: Trump informato sul blocco navale dell'Iran: cancellati i rally in Kansas e Iowa, spazio ai tele-rally
it.dek: Il presidente Trump ha annullato due comizi in presenza per le elezioni di metà mandato e parteciperà a tele-rally in 19 stati; ha inoltre ricevuto briefing su Iran e Ucraina in vista del voto.
facts: Trump ha annullato i rally in presenza a Salina, in Kansas, e a Dubuque, in Iowa, previsti per il 30 ottobre (The Jerusalem Post, CNA).
Il Comitato Nazionale Repubblicano ha annunciato che Trump parteciperà a tele-rally in 19 stati (comunicato RNC, 30 ottobre).
L'ammiraglio Brad Cooper ha informato Trump sul blocco navale dell'Iran il 29 ottobre (Axios, The Jerusalem Post).
Stazioni locali hanno riferito che la guerra in Ucraina prosegue nonostante la promessa di Trump di porvi fine (Fox5 Vegas e altri, 29 ottobre).
Il Likud e i suoi alleati hanno ottenuto 53 seggi nella Knesset israeliana di 120 membri, senza raggiungere la maggioranza (The Jerusalem Post, BBC).
Il partito di Benjamin Netanyahu ha sostenuto che le elezioni israeliane siano state rubate (South China Morning Post, Washington Post).
body: Il Comitato Nazionale Repubblicano ha dichiarato il 30 ottobre che il presidente Trump parteciperà a tele-rally in 19 stati (RNC). Le trasmissioni fanno seguito alla cancellazione degli eventi in presenza in Iowa e Kansas (CNA).

Trump ha annullato i rally previsti per sabato a Salina, in Kansas, e per domenica a Dubuque, in Iowa (The Jerusalem Post, CNA). Ha dichiarato che interverrà telefonicamente ad altri eventi di campagna invece di spostarsi (The Jerusalem Post).

L'ammiraglio Brad Cooper, capo del Comando Centrale degli Stati Uniti, ha informato giovedì il presidente Trump sullo stato del blocco navale dell'Iran (Axios, The Jerusalem Post). Il briefing ha riguardato lo stato del blocco e le possibili opzioni militari (Axios).

Le stazioni televisive locali hanno riferito che la guerra in Ucraina continua nonostante la promessa del presidente Trump di porvi fine (Fox5 Vegas e altre emittenti). Non è stato annunciato alcun cessate il fuoco e i combattimenti sono proseguiti sulle linee del fronte (Fox5 Vegas).

The Jerusalem Post ha riportato che il blocco guidato dal Likud di Benjamin Netanyahu ha vinto 53 seggi nella Knesset di 120 membri (The Jerusalem Post, BBC). Il totale non raggiunge la maggioranza, rendendo necessari i colloqui per la formazione di una coalizione (BBC).

Il partito di Benjamin Netanyahu ha sostenuto che le elezioni israeliane siano state rubate (South China Morning Post). Il Washington Post ha riportato che Netanyahu ha formulato tale accusa nel tentativo di sopravvivenza politica (Washington Post).

Il vicepresidente JD Vance ha scritto a un alto funzionario iraniano in merito a forniture mediche, e il presidente Trump ha confermato che il contatto riguardava materiale sanitario (The Straits Times, Euronews). Trump ha sottolineato la natura umanitaria della comunicazione (The Straits Times).
it.context: Le elezioni di metà mandato degli Stati Uniti del 2026 sono previste per novembre, il che ha intensificato le attività elettorali. Axios e The Jerusalem Post hanno riportato che gli Stati Uniti stanno monitorando i conflitti in Iran, Ucraina e Israele in vista del voto.

pt.title: Trump é informado sobre bloqueio do Irão enquanto guerra na Ucrânia persiste e surgem resultados eleitorais em Israel
pt.dek: Trump recebeu informações sobre o bloqueio iraniano, Vance solicitou suprimentos médicos ao Irão, os combates na Ucrânia continuam e o Likud conquista 53 lugares nas eleições israelitas, sob alegações de fraude.
facts: O partido de Benjamin Netanyahu alegou que as eleições foram roubadas (South China Morning Post, Washington Post).
Previsões indicam que o Likud e os seus aliados conquistarão 53 lugares nos 120 assentos da Knesset (Jerusalem Post, BBC).
Não emergiu um vencedor claro; esperam-se negociações para a formação de uma coligação (CBS News, DW).
O Presidente Trump foi informado sobre o bloqueio naval do Irão pelo Almirante Brad Cooper (Axios, Jerusalem Post).
O Vice-Presidente JD Vance escreveu a um alto funcionário iraniano; Trump afirmou que o contacto dizia respeito a suprimentos médicos (Straits Times, Euronews).
A guerra na Ucrânia continua, apesar da promessa de Trump de a pôr fim (Fox5 Vegas, FOX Carolina, WJHG, WMTV, KTTC, KY3, WEAU, WIBW).
body: O partido de Benjamin Netanyahu alegou que as eleições foram roubadas, segundo o South China Morning Post. O Washington Post reportou que Netanyahu fez a alegação numa tentativa de sobrevivência política.
O Likud e os seus aliados deverão conquistar 53 lugares nos 120 assentos da Knesset, de acordo com o Jerusalem Post. A BBC apresentou a mesma previsão com base em resultados parciais.
A CBS News reportou que não emergiu um vencedor claro nas eleições israelitas. A DW referiu que se esperam negociações de coligação subsequentes.

O Presidente Donald Trump foi informado sobre o bloqueio naval do Irão pelo chefe do Comando Central dos EUA, Almirante Brad Cooper, segundo a Axios. O Jerusalem Post notou que a sessão abordou o estado do bloqueio e possíveis opções militares.

O Vice-Presidente JD Vance escreveu a um alto funcionário iraniano, conforme reportado pelo Straits Times. A Euronews citou o Presidente Trump afirmando que o contacto dizia respeito a suprimentos médicos.

Diversas estações locais, incluindo Fox5 Vegas, FOX Carolina, WJHG, WMTV, KTTC, KY3, WEAU e WIBW, reportaram que a guerra na Ucrânia continua, apesar da promessa do Presidente Trump de a encerrar. Estes meios de comunicação não detalharam novos movimentos na linha da frente.

A Axios e o Jerusalem Post notaram que os Estados Unidos estão a monitorizar vários conflitos estrangeiros à medida que se aproximam as eleições de meio de mandato de 2026. As publicações listaram o Irão, a Ucrânia e Israel como as principais áreas de foco.
pt.context: A Axios e o Jerusalem Post reportaram que os Estados Unidos estão a monitorizar vários conflitos no estrangeiro à medida que se aproximam as eleições de meio de mandato de 2026. Os conflitos incluem o Irão, a Ucrânia e Israel.

zh.title: 特朗普获悉伊朗封锁情况，乌克兰战争持续，以色列选举结果出炉
zh.dek: 特朗普听取关于伊朗封锁的汇报；万斯向伊朗寻求医疗物资；乌克兰战事仍在继续；以色列选举中利库德党赢得53席，但伴随选举舞弊指控。
facts: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡所属政党指称选举被操纵（南华早报、华盛顿邮报）。
预计利库德党及其盟友将在120席的议会中赢得53席（耶路撒冷邮报、BBC）。
目前尚无明确赢家，预计将进行组阁谈判（CBS新闻、德国之声）。
特朗普总统听取了布拉德·库珀海军上将关于伊朗海上封锁的汇报（Axios、耶路撒冷邮报）。
副总统JD·万斯致信伊朗一名高级官员；特朗普表示此次接触涉及医疗物资（海峡时报、欧洲新闻台）。
尽管特朗普承诺结束乌克兰战争，但战事仍在继续（Fox5 Vegas, FOX Carolina, WJHG, MMTV, KTTC, KY3, WEAU, WIBW）。
body: 据《南华早报》报道，本雅明·内塔尼亚胡所属政党声称选举被操纵。《华盛顿邮报》则报道称，内塔尼亚胡在寻求政治生存之际提出了这一指控。
据《耶路撒冷邮报》报道，预计利库德党及其盟友将在120席的议会中赢得53席。BBC基于部分计票结果给出了相同的预测。
CBS新闻报道称，以色列选举中没有出现明确的赢家。德国之声报道称，预计随后将进行组阁谈判。
据Axios报道，美国中央司令部司令布拉德·库珀海军上将向唐纳德·特朗普总统汇报了伊朗海上封锁的情况。《耶路撒冷邮报》指出，此次汇报涵盖了封锁现状及可能的军事选项。
据《海峡时报》报道，副总统JD·万斯致信伊朗一名高级官员。欧洲新闻台援引特朗普总统的话称，此次接触涉及医疗物资。
包括Fox5 Vegas, FOX Carolina, WJHG, MMTV, KTTC, KY3, WEAU和WIBW在内的多家地方电台报道称，尽管特朗普总统承诺结束乌克兰战争，但战事仍在继续。这些媒体未详细报道前线的最新动态。
Axios和《耶路撒冷邮报》指出，随着2026年中期选举临近，美国正在密切关注几场海外冲突。这些媒体将伊朗、乌克兰和以色列列为重点关注领域。
zh.context: Axios和《耶路撒冷邮报》报道称，随着2026年中期选举临近，美国正在监测包括伊朗、乌克兰和以色列在内的几场海外冲突。

ja.title: トランプ氏、イランの封鎖について報告受ける　ウクライナ戦争継続、イスラエル選挙結果も判明
ja.dek: トランプ氏はイランによる封鎖について報告を受け、ヴァンス氏はイランに医療物資を要請。ウクライナでは戦闘が続き、イスラエル選挙ではリクード党が53議席を獲得したが、選挙盗用を主張する声が上がっている。
facts: ベンヤミン・ネタニヤフ首相の政党が、選挙が盗まれたと主張（サウスチャイナモーニングポスト、ワシントン・ポスト）。
リクード党とその同盟者が、120議席のクネセト（イスラエル議会）で53議席を獲得する見通し（エルサレム・ポスト、BBC）。
明確な勝者は現れず、連立交渉が行われる見込み（CBSニュース、DW）。
トランプ大統領がブラッド・クーパー提督からイランの海上封鎖について報告を受けた（アクシオス、エルサレム・ポスト）。
JD・ヴァンス副大統領がイラン高官に書簡を送付。トランプ氏は、医療物資に関する働きかけであると述べた（ストレイツ・タイムズ、ユーロニュース）。
トランプ氏による終結の公約にもかかわらず、ウクライナでの戦争が継続している（Fox5 Vegas、FOX Carolina、WJHG、WMTV、KTTC、KY3、WEAU、WIBW）。
body: サウスチャイナモーニングポストによると、ベンヤミン・ネタニヤフ首相の政党が、今回の選挙は盗まれたと主張した。ワシントン・ポストは、ネタニヤフ氏が政治的生存をかけてこの主張を行ったと報じている。
エルサレム・ポストは、リクード党とその同盟者が120議席のクネセトで53議席を獲得する見通しであると報じた。BBCも一部の結果に基づき、同様の予測を示している。
CBSニュースは、イスラエル選挙において明確な勝者は現れなかったと報じた。DWは、今後、連立交渉が行われる見通しであると伝えている。
アクシオスによると、ドナルド・トランプ大統領は、米中央軍司令官のブラッド・クーパー提督からイランの海上封鎖について報告を受けた。エルサレム・ポストは、この報告に封鎖の現状と軍事的な選択肢が含まれていたと記している。
ストレイツ・タイムズは、JD・ヴァンス副大統領がイラン高官に書簡を送ったと報じた。ユーロニュースは、この働きかけは医療物資に関するものであるというトランプ大統領の言葉を引用した。
Fox5 Vegas、FOX Carolina、WJHG、WMTV、KTTC、KY3、WEAU、WIBWなど複数の地方局は、トランプ大統領が終結を公約したにもかかわらず、ウクライナでの戦争が続いていると報じた。これらのメディアは、前線における新たな動きについては詳述していない。
アクシオスとエルサレム・ポストは、2026年の中間選挙が近づく中、米国が複数の海外紛争を注視していると指摘した。重点領域として、イラン、ウクライナ、イスラエルが挙げられている。
ja.context: アクシオスとエルサレム・ポストは、2026年の中間選挙が近づく中、米国がイラン、ウクライナ、イスラエルを含む複数の海外紛争を注視していると報じた。

ko.title: 트럼프, 이란 봉쇄 상황 보고 받아... 우크라이나 전쟁 지속 및 이스라엘 선거 결과 발표
ko.dek: 트럼프 대통령이 이란의 봉쇄 조치에 대해 보고받은 가운데, 밴스 부통령은 이란에 의료 물자를 요청했다. 우크라이나에서는 교전이 계속되고 있으며, 이스라엘 선거에서는 부정 선거 주장이 제기된 가운데 리쿠드당이 53석을 확보했다.
facts: 베냐민 네타냐후 총리가 이끄는 정당은 이번 선거가 도둑맞았다고 주장했다 (사우스차이나모닝포스트, 워싱턴포스트).
리쿠드당과 그 동맹 세력이 120석 규모의 크네세트(이스라엘 의회)에서 53석을 확보할 것으로 전망됐다 (예루살렘포스트, BBC).
뚜렷한 승자가 나타나지 않아 연합 정부 구성 협상이 예상된다 (CBS 뉴스, DW).
트럼프 대통령은 브래드 쿠퍼 제독으로부터 이란의 해상 봉쇄 상황을 보고받았다 (액시오스, 예루살렘포스트).
JD 밴스 부통령이 이란 고위 관리에게 서한을 보냈으며, 트럼프 대통령은 해당 연락이 의료 물자 조달과 관련이 있다고 밝혔다 (스트레이츠 타임스, 유로뉴스).
트럼프 대통령의 종전 약속에도 불구하고 우크라이나 전쟁은 계속되고 있다 (Fox5 Vegas, FOX Carolina, WJHG, WMTV, KTTC, KY3, WEAU, WIBW).
body: 사우스차이나모닝포스트에 따르면 베냐민 네타냐후 총리의 정당은 이번 선거가 부정하게 치러졌다고 주장했다. 워싱턴포스트는 네타냐후 총리가 정치적 생존을 모색하며 이러한 주장을 제기했다고 보도했다.
예루살렘포스트는 리쿠드당과 그 동맹 세력이 120석 규모의 크네세트에서 53석을 차지할 것으로 전망했다. BBC 역시 부분 집계 결과를 바탕으로 동일한 전망을 내놓았다.
CBS 뉴스는 이스라엘 선거에서 압도적인 승자가 나타나지 않았다고 보도했다. DW는 이에 따라 연합 정부 구성을 위한 협상이 이어질 것으로 예상했다.
액시오스에 따르면 도널드 트럼프 대통령은 브래드 쿠퍼 미 중앙사령관으로부터 이란의 해상 봉쇄 상황을 보고받았다. 예루살렘포스트는 이번 보고에서 봉쇄 현황과 가능한 군사적 대응 방안이 다뤄졌다고 전했다.
스트레이츠 타임스는 JD 밴스 부통령이 이란 고위 관리에게 서한을 보냈다고 보도했다. 유로뉴스는 트럼프 대통령이 해당 접촉이 의료 물자 지원에 관한 것이라고 언급했다고 전했다.
Fox5 Vegas, FOX Carolina, WJHG, WMTV, KTTC, KY3, WEAU, WIBW 등 다수의 지역 방송사는 트럼프 대통령의 종전 약속에도 불구하고 우크라이나 전쟁이 지속되고 있다고 보도했다. 다만, 이들 매체는 전선의 새로운 움직임에 대해서는 구체적으로 다루지 않았다.
액시오스와 예루살렘포스트는 2026년 중간선거가 다가옴에 따라 미국이 여러 해외 분쟁 상황을 예의주시하고 있다고 전했다. 이들 매체는 주요 관심 지역으로 이란, 우크라이나, 이스라엘을 꼽았다.
ko.context: 액시오스와 예루살렘포스트는 2026년 중간선거를 앞두고 미국이 이란, 우크라이나, 이스라엘을 포함한 여러 해외 분쟁 상황을 모니터링하고 있다고 보도했다.

en.dek: President Trump received a briefing on the Iran naval blockade, canceled two in-person midterm rallies, and continued to monitor the Ukraine conflict as election season progresses.
body: President Donald Trump canceled in‑person rallies scheduled for Saturday in Salina, Kansas, and Sunday in Dubuque, Iowa. He will instead phone in to other midterm campaign events, and the outlets said the cancellations were made on Friday, according to The Jerusalem Post and CNA.

U.S. Central Command chief Admiral Brad Cooper briefed President Trump on the Iran naval blockade. The briefing covered the blockade’s status and possible military options, according to Axios and The Jerusalem Post.

Multiple local stations, including Fox5 Vegas, reported that the war in Ukraine continues despite President Trump’s promise to end it. The reports noted no new ceasefire was announced, and they cited ongoing fighting on the front lines.

The Jerusalem Post reported that the bloc led by Benjamin Netanyahu’s Likud won 53 seats in the 120‑seat Knesset. The BBC confirmed the figure and added that the total falls short of a majority, meaning coalition talks will be required.

Benjamin Netanyahu’s party alleged the election was stolen, according to the South China Morning Post. The Washington Post said Netanyahu made the claim while seeking political survival, and the allegation has been repeated in his public statements.

Vice President JD Vance wrote to a senior Iranian official about medical supplies, according to The Straits Times and Euronews. President Trump said the outreach concerned medical supplies, and he emphasized the humanitarian focus of the contact.
facts: President Donald Trump canceled in‑person rallies in Salina, Kansas, and Dubuque, Iowa (The Jerusalem Post, CNA).
Admiral Brad Cooper briefed Trump on the Iran naval blockade (Axios, The Jerusalem Post).
Local stations reported the Ukraine war continues despite Trump’s promise to end it (Fox5 Vegas and other outlets).
Likud and allies secured 53 seats in the 120‑seat Knesset, short of a majority (The Jerusalem Post, BBC).
Netanyahu’s party claimed the Israeli election was stolen (South China Morning Post, The Washington Post).
Vice President JD Vance contacted a senior Iranian official about medical supplies, and Trump said the outreach related to medical supplies (The Straits Times, Euronews).
en.title: Trump briefed on Iran blockade, cancels weekend midterm rallies amid Ukraine war
en.context: The 2026 U.S. midterm elections are set for November, prompting heightened attention to foreign policy issues. Axios and The Jerusalem Post reported that the United States is monitoring conflicts in Iran, Ukraine and Israel as the election approaches.

de.dek: Präsident Trump wurde über die iranische Seeblockade informiert, sagte zwei persönliche Kundgebungen zu den Zwischenwahlen ab und beobachtet den Ukraine-Konflikt im fortschreitenden Wahlkampf weiterhin.
body: Präsident Donald Trump sagte die für Samstag in Salina, Kansas, und Sonntag in Dubuque, Iowa, geplanten persönlichen Kundgebungen ab. Er wird stattdessen telefonisch an anderen Veranstaltungen zum Zwischenwahlkampf teilnehmen; laut The Jerusalem Post und CNA erfolgten die Absagen am Freitag.

Der Chef des U.S. Central Command, Admiral Brad Cooper, informierte Präsident Trump über die iranische Seeblockade. Das Briefing behandelte den Status der Blockade und mögliche militärische Optionen, so Axios und The Jerusalem Post.

Mehrere lokale Sender, darunter Fox5 Vegas, berichteten, dass der Krieg in der Ukraine trotz des Versprechens von Präsident Trump, ihn zu beenden, andauere. Die Berichte merkten an, dass kein neuer Waffenstillstand bekannt gegeben wurde, und verwiesen auf anhaltende Kämpfe an den Frontlinien.

The Jerusalem Post berichtete, dass der von Benjamin Netanjahus Likud geführte Block 53 Sitze in der 120-sitzigen Knesset gewann. Die BBC bestätigte die Zahl und fügte hinzu, dass die Gesamtzahl hinter einer Mehrheit zurückbleibt, was Koalitionsgespräche erforderlich macht.

Benjamin Netanyahus Partei behauptete laut der South China Morning Post, die Wahl sei gestohlen worden. The Washington Post schrieb, Netanyahu habe diese Behauptung im Kampf um sein politisches Überleben aufgestellt, und die Anschuldigung sei in seinen öffentlichen Erklärungen wiederholt worden.

Vizepräsident JD Vance schrieb an einen hochrangigen iranischen Beamten über medizinische Hilfsgüter, so The Straits Times und Euronews. Präsident Trump sagte, die Kontaktaufnahme beträfe medizinische Hilfsgüter, und betonte den humanitären Fokus des Kontakts.

body: President Donald Trump received a briefing on the Iran naval blockade from U.S. Central Command chief Admiral Brad Cooper on Thursday. Axios and The Jerusalem Post reported that the briefing covered the blockade’s status and possible military options, and they said the discussion included potential response scenarios.

Vice President JD Vance sent a letter to a senior Iranian official, and Trump said the outreach concerned medical supplies. The Straits Times and Euronews cited the letter as an attempt to revive peace talks, and they noted that Trump linked the outreach to medical supplies.

Multiple local stations confirmed that the war in Ukraine continues despite Trump’s earlier promise to end it. Fox5 Vegas, FOX Carolina, WJHG, WMTV, KTTC, KY3, WEAU and WIBW all reported ongoing hostilities. No new front‑line movements were detailed, and reporters did not provide further analysis.

The bloc led by Benjamin Netanyahu won 53 seats in Israel’s 120‑seat Knesset, according to The Times of India. The same outlet noted that the total falls short of a majority, and it positions the bloc as the largest parliamentary group.

CBS News and DW reported that no clear winner emerged in the Israeli election, and coalition negotiations are expected. Both outlets said the lack of a majority will require talks among parties, and coalition formation could take weeks.

The Jerusalem Post and the BBC projected Likud and its allies as the largest party with 53 seats based on partial results. These projections were released after vote counts were tallied, and they indicated Likud’s lead over other parties.

Axios and The Jerusalem Post noted that the United States is monitoring several foreign conflicts as the 2026 midterm elections approach, and they listed Iran, Ukraine and Israel among the key areas of focus.

Dieselben Quellen merkten an, dass Vances Kontakt darauf abzielt, diplomatische Kanäle zum Iran zu öffnen. Weitere Einzelheiten zum Inhalt des Schreibens wurden nicht bekannt gegeben.

Mehrere lokale Sender berichteten, dass der Krieg in der Ukraine trotz Trumps früherem Versprechen, ihn zu beenden, andauert, unter Berufung auf Fox5 Vegas, FOX Carolina, WJHG, WMTV, KTTC, KY3, WEAU und WIBW. Die Berichte enthielten keine neuen Informationen zu Frontbewegungen.
Der Konflikt besteht seit seinem Beginn im Jahr 2022, und die Medien gaben keine aktuellen Frontverläufe an. Sie bestätigten lediglich die anhaltenden Feindseligkeiten.

The Jerusalem Post und die BBC prognostizierten, dass Likud und seine Verbündeten basierend auf Teilergebnissen vom 29. Oktober 2026 53 Sitze in der 120-sitzigen Knesset Israels halten würden, was sie zur größten Partei machen würde. Die Prognose wurde nach der Auszählung der Stimmen veröffentlicht.

Die Prognose wurde als neuester Indikator für die parlamentarische Zusammensetzung Israels vor den Koalitionsgesprächen gemeldet. Zum Zeitpunkt der Berichterstattung waren noch keine endgültigen Ergebnisse zertifiziert worden.

Vice President JD Vance wrote to a senior Iranian official, and Trump said the outreach related to medical supplies, according to The Straits Times and Euronews. The letter was described as an attempt to revive peace talks.
The same sources noted that Vance’s contact aimed to open diplomatic channels with Iran. No further details on the content of the letter were provided.

Multiple local stations reported that the war in Ukraine continues despite Trump’s earlier promise to end it, citing Fox5 Vegas, FOX Carolina, WJHG, WMTV, KTTC, KY3, WEAU, and WIBW. The reports gave no new information on front‑line movements.
The conflict has persisted since its 2022 start, and the outlets did not specify current front‑line locations. They only confirmed ongoing hostilities.

The projection was reported as the latest indicator of Israel’s parliamentary composition ahead of coalition talks. No final results had been certified at the time of reporting.
